headline: Eurozone Consumer Confidence Expected to Decline on Rising Energy Costs
summary: Flash euro area consumer confidence indicators for October are projected to show a modest decline, weighed down by recent increases in regional energy and fuel prices.
why: Consumer confidence is a leading indicator for private consumption and retail sales across the European Union.

impacts.name: Eurozone Retail
impacts.why: Higher heating and fuel expenses divert household budgets away from discretionary consumer goods.
